task.subject: Mail eDiscovery export chain-of-custody domain slice
task.description:
ChangeSet: cs-mail-ediscovery-export-chain-custody-domain-fd001-alignment.
Objective: advance P04/connect-mail FD-001 compliance depth after legal-hold approval, workflow handoff consent, and retention deletion guards by adding a pure mail-domain eDiscovery export manifest / chain-of-custody decision surface. This must make export evidence deterministic before any adapter/PST/MBOX implementation claims.
Authority anchors: specs/root-hub-pointers.json -> docs/AGENTS.md -> specs/masterplan.json FD-001 mail surface -> specs/master-plan-sequencing.json -> .omc/plans/milestones/M07-first-tenant/phases/P04-connect-pro-mail/{phase-spec.md,impl-plan.md} and microservices/mail/IP-012-ediscovery-export.md. Relevant live anchors: legal hold + eDiscovery export, retention policies, immutable audit log, eDiscovery export <=5 min for 100k messages, eDiscovery export bundle format + chain-of-custody verifier, no Personal-context export.
Write scope: ONLY /Users/jasonlee/oyatie-worktrees/fd001-worker1-mail-context-20260520T115222Z/crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs and exact evidence paths evidence/fd001/cs-mail-ediscovery-export-chain-custody-domain-fd001-alignment-* plus evidence/multispectrum/cs-mail-ediscovery-export-chain-custody-domain-fd001-alignment.json. Do not touch Cargo/root manifests/contracts/registries/adapters/docs or other workers' scopes.
Implementation shape: domain-only, zero I/O, no placeholder/stub. Add small deterministic types/functions near existing legal-hold/retention guards for eDiscovery export manifest approval: export request with tenant/mailbox/legal_hold/export_id/format/requester/approver/generated_at/message_count/total_bytes/chunk_count/manifest_digest/previous_chain_digest; refuse Personal/cross-context, invalid ids, missing explicit eDiscovery legal-hold approval, requester=approver, zero message_count/chunk_count, empty digest, unsupported format, and chain digest gaps when continuation is required. Emit audit-ready approved manifest receipt with stable event kind and chain-of-custody fields. Keep boundary-first refusal ordering consistent with existing StrictMailLegalHoldGuard/MailRetentionDeletionDecisionGuard.
Required steps: read current lib.rs/tests and IP-012/P04 anchors before editing; run planning-closure start gate; run Oya VCS claim for crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs::MailEDiscoveryExportChainCustodyGuard; implement focused tests; verify cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo test -p oya-connect-mail-domain -- --nocapture, cargo nextest run -p oya-connect-mail-domain, cargo clippy -p oya-connect-mail-domain --all-targets -- -D warnings, planning-closure, data-class, architecture-boundaries, catalog, dependency-seam, oya git diff --check; Oya VCS verify/done/promote; commit with Lore trailers; transition task complete and report evidence. If infeasible, record exact blocker and next-best evidence; do not claim done without current evidence.
